excluded: the Sinkhorn plan and argmax code selection: non-differentiable assignment and not a new loss term
the Poincare exp/log/distance and Karcher-mean computations: used only inside the assignment, not in the objective
the straight-through quantiser: its forward value is the hard codeword and it only enters the unchanged baseline reconstruction and commitment losses
the 90th-percentile residual statistics q_l, remaining-mass statistics S_l, and previous-epoch hard-code table refresh: data-dependent epoch state, not a differentiable per-item loss
